text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Normal... Everyone always talks about 
what's normal, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What's considered "normal" at Tracen 
Academy doesn't feel very normal at all, 
maybe~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's just do some regular 
practice, let's do it, do it, do it~! Mun!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sprints, weight training, gate practice... 
Wait, we're doing all this in one day...!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, third place, third place, and 
third place again... I can't break out of 
being average. I just can't win...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: To the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone's standard for "ordinary" is way 
too high~. Someone "normal" is a girl like 
me, right?)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I can't just take daily hard work for 
granted! Now that I think about it, ever 
since I was little—)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Cu-chan, you did so good in the footrace! 
Think you might run in real races when you 
grow up~?

text_block_list.name: Young Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Races... I wonder if they're fun~...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy... I can't believe I 
actually passed. This isn't a dream, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Freshman Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Mirako. Why are you here?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why? Well~, maybe because the people 
around me cheered me on a bit, or had 
expectations for me, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't decide on a career path either, 
and I just thought it'd be cool to spend 
my youth somewhere super famous, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A mock race...? I think I'll pass this 
time. I'm pretty busy, too...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh, forget about that, what am I gonna 
do about the test~? If I get a bad grade 
and my allowance gets cut~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I never really had much of a will of my 
own, I just drifted toward whatever seemed 
fun...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Even after entering Tracen Academy, I 
naturally never imagined I'd actually run 
in the Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I was just living a totally normal 
student life. And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...I just ran into them, you know, out of 
nowhere. That person who changed my 
everyday life.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's going to happen to me 
now...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haah...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah, hah-heee~...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, that again~?!
choice_data_list: You can do it if you put your mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, if you say that much—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing else for it...! 
Haaaaahhhhh!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... So exhausteedd... Water, 
please...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Hishi Miracle. Seeing 
her potential, I signed an exclusive 
contract with her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, why'd you even pick such a 
sluggish girl? Isn't it a huge pain to 
constantly push her~?
choice_data_list:
Still, because she always rises to the 
occasion!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sluggish... In other words, unable to 
initiate moves on her own, and slow to get 
the engine running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I don't speak to her and constantly 
push her with praise, she loses her drive. 
But—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Huh...? Did I... actually 
put up a fight...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She ran alongside the already-debuted 
model student Umamusume, Narita Top Road, 
and put up a great fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up until then, she had lost 9 consecutive 
mock races at the academy. Yet when 
genuine expectations were placed on her, 
Hishi Miracle would always rise to meet 
them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, debuting in the Twinkle Series 
means~...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Going back to everyday student life as 
usual... isn't an option, is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I see~. Take it easy with racing, go to a 
sports university, and get a job at a 
sports company...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I guess this is goodbye to that humble 
little path, huh.
choice_data_list: Could it be... you don't like it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"No... not quite. It's not really a matter 
of good or bad in the first place~."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm usually the type to just think, "It'd 
be nice if things kinda worked out 
well..." That's pretty much it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I have motivation, just not a whole lot. 
—I'll try my best, but I can't push myself 
too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That was Hishi Miracle—an utterly 
ordinary Umamusume, no, an utterly 
ordinary 'just-a-girl.'"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
By the way~... Trainer. You're not 
thinking that just because we're debuting, 
we have to win... are you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: That's just a wishful hope... right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, talk about motivated! I mean, 
winning would be nice for me too, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If she can make a safe debut and manage to 
win one or two races, that'd be great.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you can manage that, it'll truly be a 
miracle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you chase it, it shines... but if you 
don't, it stays dull. There are no 
promises, nor are there any guarantees. 
There is nothing at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how far can this "totally average" 
Hishi Miracle go? Her down-to-earth 
challenge begins now.
